_README: Scout notes for one course: the scorecard and one sourced read per hole. Contract in lib/scout.ts (parseScoutCourse) and scripts/validate.mjs.

Nothing numeric lives here except the scorecard — a bunker's carry, a green's depth and where a tee set stands are computed from public/data/holes/<slug>.geojson so the card cannot disagree with the map.
Every hole note carries a `source` key into `sources`. `unread` is the honest absence: no published read of that green was found, so the default (centre of the green, miss away from sand) stands.

nbc2009 describes the 2009 Presidents Cup ROUTING, which started on today's 10th. Its hole N is today's: 1→10 2→11 3→12 4→13 5→4 6→5 7→6 8→2 9→3 10→14 11→8 12→15 13→16 14→17 15→18 16→1 17→7 18→9 (mapped by par and yardage, 2026-10-13).
pga and cbs describe the 2020 PGA Championship setup (hole 12 played as a par 4 at 494; the public card is a par 5 at 450/480). Hazard reads carry over; the tournament yardages do not.
osm: hole 18 has no centreline in OSM — the card draws the watch's tee→pin from 2026-08-20 and says so. Hole 9 has no green polygon — a 26 m disc stands in at the line's end, flagged approximate.

arccos.title: Arccos — Caddie Rangefinder and Preview, TPC Harding Park
arccos.note: elevation and wind notes: hole 3 climbs 17 ft, hole 10 climbs 22 ft, 14–18 along Lake Merced

unread.title: No published read found
unread.note: the default stands: centre of the green, miss on the side away from sand

tee.why: Open off the tee. A drive to the left side leaves a slightly downhill second into a receptive green.

hazards.what: large greenside bunker guarding a short-right miss

green.note: One big bunker short right; the middle of the green is a birdie look.

target.text: Middle of the green and a birdie look. Nothing right.

tee.why: Two fairway bunkers down the left catch any drive squeezing for yards; mature cypress flanks the right. Favour the right side.

hazards.what: two fairway bunkers down the left

green.missDead: Long — the green is crowned and runs away
green.note: Crowned green with a front-right bunker; the approach wants to come in from below the hole.

target.text: Par is a good score here. Middle of the green, whatever the flag.

tee.why: Uphill 17 ft to a two-tier green you cannot read from the tee; wind between the cypress. Locals pull an extra club — long beats the two bunkers short.

hazards.what: two bunkers short of the green

green.note: Two tiers; the long miss is the favourable one.

target.text: Take the extra club. Over the green beats the bunkers short, every time.

tee.why: True dogleg left with a large cypress guarding the corner — do not get greedy. A fairway wood off the tee for the fairway; it is a three-shot hole.

hazards.what: large cypress at the corner of the dogleg

green.note: No published read of the green; the dramatic second turn left keeps it out of reach in two.

target.text: Three shots. Hybrid, hybrid, wedge. Hole 1 on the card for a reason — bogey is fine.

tee.why: The only hole without a bunker and among the tightest fairways, trees both sides — the field hits irons off this tee.

hazards.what: trees both sides of a tight fairway
significant drop-off right of the green

green.note: Deep, narrow green with contours and a steep fall-off on the right.

target.text: Hybrid down the middle, then the left half of a narrow green. Right is a chip from the bottom of a hill.

tee.why: A chute through the trees, then the fairway turns left; one of the toughest driving holes. In the trees, par is a great score.

hazards.what: tall trees at the corner, left

green.note: Wide green with a subtle centre hump, protected front and left.

target.text: Find the fairway first. Then the right half of the green — the sand is all front-left.

tee.why: Short par 4: know where the flag is, then hit the tee shot that gives the best route in — fairway bunker left, rough and trees right.

green.missDead: Either side — bunker shots and chips
green.note: No published read of the green beyond this: missing it leaves bunker shots and chips.

target.text: Leave yourself a full wedge, not a half one. Green in two, two putts, move on.

tee.why: Brutally long par 3, downhill to a hard green that is difficult to hold: grass bunker left, sand right.

hazards.what: sand bunker right of the green
grass bunker left of the green

green.note: Firm and hard to hold; a right flag demands clearing the bunker.

target.text: Left half of the green. A chip from the grass beats a bunker shot; a 3 is a win.

tee.why: Three fairway bunkers down the right. Aggressive drive is fine — away from them.

green.note: Front bunkers and a gentle front-to-back slope.

target.text: The easiest hole on the card. Three shots, the third one past the front bunkers.

tee.why: Gentle dogleg left with fairway bunkers on the right — the only thing to avoid off the tee. Uphill 22 ft tee to green.

hazards.what: three bunkers around a green set among trees

green.missDead: Any of the three bunkers; long into the trees
green.note: Reachable in two for the field; three bunkers and trees around it.

target.text: Uphill all the way — one more club on the second and the third. Lay up short of the sand.

tee.why: Downhill to a small green flanked by bunkers both sides; the prevailing wind is right to left, so start it over the larger left bunker.

hazards.what: bunkers both sides of the green

green.note: Back-left and back-right pins are the sternest.

target.text: Centre of the green, ignore the flag. Sand both sides.

tee.why: Bends right to left with out of bounds down the ENTIRE left side; Monterey pines right. A fairway metal off the tee for position.

hazards.what: out of bounds the whole left side
fairway bunkers short of the turn
two bunker sets either side of the green

green.missDead: Left — OB side; either side is sand
green.note: Trees surround the green with bunkers both sides.

target.text: OB left the whole way. Right side, three shots, no heroics.

tee.why: Fairway bunker down the right and overhanging cypress; a left miss is in the trees. Lake Merced comes into view on the second and the wind makes the number hard to judge.

hazards.what: deep bunker left of the green

green.missDead: Left — the deep bunker the green hooks around
green.note: The green hooks around a deep left-side bunker; left pins are restricted by it.

target.text: Right half of the green. The left bunker is the double.

tee.why: Uphill along Lake Merced; a gully on the left and a fairway that slopes left. The approach is from an uneven lie and plays longer than it looks.

hazards.what: sand left of the green, grass bunker right

green.missDead: Left — sand; long leaves a downhill putt on a quick green
green.note: Slopes back to front; sand left, grass right; wind hard to judge through the trees.

target.text: Uphill and longer than it looks — one more club, right half, below the hole.

tee.why: Tree-lined, curls left toward the lake; fairway bunker right. A fairway metal or less off the tee; the bold driver faces a side-hill lie.

green.missDead: Long — above the hole on a plateau that runs back to front
green.note: Plateau green sloping back to front; the short iron must finish below the hole.

target.text: Hybrid, then a short iron below the hole. Over this green is a three-putt.

tee.why: Short par 4 — drivable for the field — bunkers left and overhanging cypress. Three bunkers guard the left of a small green, one the right.

green.note: Small green nestled among trees, three bunkers left and one right.

target.text: Not a driver hole for you — leave a full wedge, hit the green, take the 4.

tee.why: The shortest par 3, exposed to the wind on the left and tougher than it looks; front bunkers guard both edges.

green.note: Somewhat crowned, bunkers around; the Pacific breeze is the hard part.

target.text: Enough club to carry the front bunkers. The wind off the left is real.

tee.why: Doglegs left around the lake with two large fairway bunkers right. Risk and reward — for you, the fairway.

green.missDead: Short — it spins back off the front toward the fairway
green.note: Short shots spin backward toward the fairway; take the back half.

target.text: Second-hardest hole on the card. Fairway, back half of the green, and a bogey is a fine finish.
